fact: The World Bank concept note of 7 July 2021 for the Sudan Data and Statistics Strengthening Project (P177123, US$50 million IDA grant, implemented with the Central Bureau of Statistics) proposes to improve availability and quality of administrative data in the education and health sectors, building on the P167988 project whose HECRA assessment covered the education management information system (EMIS) and the health inpatient register.
title: Concept Project Information Document (PID) - Sudan Data and Statistics Strengthening Project - P177123
